notes: Follow-up controlled experiment after the 2026-11-23 multitask test evaluation.
Uses 4-bit NF4 QLoRA, SDPA attention, and non-reentrant gradient checkpointing to reduce peak VRAM while preserving the full 8192-token dataset context and trainable LoRA adapters.
Keeps the current task-separated dataset, model, LoRA modules, optimizer settings, sequence length, and epoch count fixed.
Samples Bloom rewrite at 50% of training examples and QA/summarization at 25% each to test whether equal row sampling under-trains the primary Bloom rewrite task.
Validation remains unweighted and task-stratified. Select using validation only; evaluate the held-out test once after model selection.
The task-weight change is an experiment, not a guaranteed improvement. Preserve the original run and use fresh output and results directories.
